hypothesis: Running DWPose-L ONNX at >288x384 input would yield sub-pixel keypoint precision and improve Layer 2 joint angle |r|.
result: BLOCKED at gate 1 — ONNX has fixed spatial input shape.

gate_1_dynamic_input.evidence: onnxruntime InferenceSession.get_inputs()[0].shape returns ['batch', 3, 384, 288] — spatial dims are fixed literals, not symbolic dim_params. Empirical run confirms ORT raises INVALID_ARGUMENT for any other (H,W).

gate_2_higher_res_layer1.reason: Blocked by gate 1 — cannot feed 432x576 into the fixed-shape ONNX.

latency_baseline_384x288.note: Single-image batch=1. The 12.6 ms CoreML number is the on-device proxy budget.

verdict: SHELVE — at the ONNX level this lever is dead. Higher input resolution requires re-export from the original PyTorch checkpoint with new SimCC head bin counts, which is out of scope ('Don't retrain the model'). Layer 1 is already at r=0.98 — the Layer 2 ceiling is dominated by 2D->joint-angle ambiguity, not keypoint sub-pixel error.
